purpose: Portable snapshot of the existing descriptive AC16 marker contrasts used to specify the human oxygen-response directions before inspecting GSE144424 donor effects.

calculation.mean_tpm: Arithmetic mean of each marker across the three profiles assigned to the oxygen arm.
calculation.contrast: log2((arm mean TPM + 1)/(20% reference mean TPM + 1))

verification.procedure: Recomputed all 32 gene-arm means and contrasts from the hashed tracked TPM matrix and metadata; checked every snapshot value and marker-presence flag.

limitations: The 12 RNA profiles represent one cell-line identity, not 12 independent donors; independent culture-preparation identities are not established.
Exposure durations and matched baseline/treated pairing are not supplied in the inspected metadata.
The 20% arm is an assigned incubator reference, not a measurement of intracellular oxygen.
Contrasts are descriptive summaries, not differential-expression significance tests or evidence of cardiac injury, functional recovery or causality.
All 12 profiles are retained, including visually unusual expression profiles; no exclusions were selected from marker effects.
GSE144424 uses donor-derived human iPSC cardiomyocytes and a 10% reference; compare directions, not magnitudes across the TPM and normalized-count scales.
This reference does not pool species, fit or score a model, or define or modify a frozen benchmark or split.
